canonical_project: Zaporizhzhia 1 GW data processing center project
owner: Energoatom; Hotmine; Yom Capital; local Zaporizhzhia authorities
notes: 2020 reports said Energoatom and partners planned a data center near Zaporizhzhia NPP, with first-stage capacity of 250 MW and planned expansion up to 1,000 MW. No recent evidence of construction completion found.
